summary: Stage-A wave 1 complete per GROUPING_PROPOSAL 5.2 item 1: 64 new T1_RULE_READY corpus legs implemented as exact frozen rules (29 archetypes in research/pc12a/leg_rules.py; 64 configs under legs_config/; one frozen param set per leg with param_source corpus_verbatim|triage_default recorded per config), 9 T1 legs PARKED_IMPL (required cross inputs Brent/VIX/AUDUSD/USDCAD-derived series are not staged on this checkout; no arm was forced), 2 T1 legs were already implemented as exemplars. Exact-arm DRY-RUN (NO PnL anywhere; leak scan clean on every pass) over the full 286-Friday window 2021-01-08..2026-06-26 for all 84 campaign arms, executed as 5 symbol-split passes (runtime; EURUSD->USDJPY->GBPUSD with exported/imported D1 cross feeds, USDJPY-S050 solo for its 760-day FDR warmup, GBPUSD-S090 solo after a state fix). Mechanization screening in the new append-only discovery ledger TRIAL_LEDGER.jsonl (85 rows = 84 arms + the T2 exemplar EURUSD-S009): T1 legs 46 IMPLEMENTED floor-pass / 6 FLOOR_FAIL (<20 decisions full window: USDJPY-S001 3, USDJPY-S009 3, USDJPY-S029 10, USDJPY-S044 12, USDJPY-S045 2, EURUSD-S027 16) / 14 IMPLEMENTED with dry-run NOT_RUN (AUDUSD/USDCAD have no staged M1 panels; floor NOT_RUN is a data fact, not a rule failure) / 9 PARKED_IMPL. VOLPROF controls re-screened by the same run: VC2/VC3 6 IMPLEMENTED, VC1 3 FLOOR_FAIL (0-2 decisions - its VA-edge rejection condition is very strict). Engine additions (leak-proof preserved, self-grepping unchanged): minute-clock leg path (wants_every_bar non-VOLPROF legs decided on every tradable M1 bar with a warmup gate so legs enter the window flat), cross-asset D1 feed plumbing (dependency-ordered symbol streaming; legs PIT-filter feeds to dates <= their own bar date), missing-panel symbols recorded as legs_not_run instead of crashing, --export-dailies/--import-dailies for symbol-split passes, BarContext gains mid_high/mid_low/bid_volume. 172 new tests in tests/test_pc12a_stageA_wave1.py; full suite 2223 passing (1 pre-existing unrelated failure file excluded: tests/test_family_failures.py, broken at HEAD - wayfinder registry, not this lane's tree). Governance batteries (arm-distinctness, pit-joins, truncation-prefix) updated for the 76-config dir with intent preserved; L5 placeholder cluster map extended with the 23 wave-1 (family,horizon) cluster ids at the same 100k placeholder cap (Stage-B re-freezes).

key_notes: DISPATCH COUNT DELTA: the dispatch said 72 remaining T1 legs; the actual count is 73 (75 T1 rows - 2 already-implemented exemplars; EURUSD-S009 is T2_DEFAULTS_DECLARED, not one of the 75).

DATA DISCLOSURE: only EURUSD/GBPUSD/USDJPY have audited M1 panels on this checkout (Lane-D audit covers 3 pairs). The 14 implemented AUDUSD/USDCAD legs are code+config-complete but their dry-run and F1 floor are NOT_RUN (data); their configs carry cost_tier PANEL_VENUE_UNSTAGED_DECLARED_TBD.

PARKED (9) with exact reasons in the ledger: USDJPY-S064 (Brent), USDJPY-S066 (VIX), USDJPY-S070 (AUDJPY needs AUDUSD), AUDUSD-S066/S069/S082/S083 (AUDUSD/USDCAD-derived crosses), AUDUSD-S091 (VIX), USDCAD-S068 (CADJPY). The triage called these inputs evidenced (G-PIT-V2/V3) but no such series is staged here.

GBPUSD-S086 MECHANIZATION_DEVIATION (visible in its config): corpus places VIX>20 in the Coupling field, the triage baked it into the rule; VIX is not staged so the coupling is declared OFF with the deviation flagged; momentum definition declared = USDJPY D1 EMA20 vs EMA50.

Corpus-vs-triage param findings (each disclosed in the config notes): GBPUSD-S024 target mechanized as 1.5R (corpus 'day-range extreme' not literal); USDJPY-S017 stop declared at the Asia extreme (corpus 'outside London H/L' unknowable at entry); EURUSD-S020 BBW percentile window declared = 2880 M5 bars; USDJPY-S050 FDR method declared = Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.05 over 48 half-hour slots; gate-role legs carry declared standalone position mappings (S027-exemplar precedent).

Late fixes found by the wave's own screening (both re-run through final passes): (1) sessions spanning UTC midnight (Asia JST, overnight sweep) had their state wiped at the day flip - USDJPY-S017 went 0 -> 100 decisions, GBPUSD-S090 re-run; (2) box/fade setups (GBPUSD-S011/S021/S024, USDJPY-S022) re-triggered all day (320K decisions on S021) - one-shot-per-session disarm added per the corpus's single-setup semantics; S022 160K -> 2762 decisions.

Bounded indicator windows: H1/H4 archetypes compute indicators over bounded trailing windows (e.g. EMA over last 100-400 aggregates) after the full-history recomputation made the combined pass O(n^2) - deterministic and prefix-identity-safe; ATR(H1) proxied by ctx.atr60 (mean TR of the last 60 M1 bars).

Daily-clock legs may enter the window holding an unjournaled warmup position (exemplar-precedent semantics); their F1 counts start at the first in-window CHANGE - relevant when reading USDJPY-S001/S009's low counts alongside their always-in-market designs.

Truncation-prefix battery: ONOFF twin rows decided at/after the cut minute are excluded from the prefix comparison (their would-fill consumes the first bar after the decision, which the truncated panel lacks) - documented in tests/test_pc12a_truncation.py.

F1 floor-fail verdicts on the VOLPROF VC1 controls (0-2 decisions) and on the USDJPY seasonal/trend exemplars are honest screening outcomes, not implementation gaps; wave 2 owns any amendment decisions.

tests/test_family_failures.py fails at HEAD on the wayfinder registry (SCORED_REJECTION/NEGATIVE_EXPECTANCY verdict codes) - pre-existing, outside this lane's write scope, excluded from the suite run.
